name: Rooms

features.text: Client transport registers during the client Lua phase; shared API and server transport retain their own load phase. UI remains the required presentation dependency.
Draw, paint, erase, merge and split designated rooms across floors; Paint/Erase mouse drags apply the complete rectangle once on release with one undo step, using normalized row-run draft editing.
A visible Delete Room action for selected saved rooms; the editor uses required B47ANCEDUI client API 1 for shared presentation.
Room types, names and storage roles; revisioned ownership, safehouse delegation and visitor policies.
Permission and geometry API for cooperating mods; building-scoped cleaning areas.
Designated-only storage membership/geometry APIs with complete-footprint configuration permission; paired allocation-provider tests.

limits: Metadata does not grant inventory access, route items or enforce unrelated vanilla actions. Native room overrides stay removed. Native/dedicated NOT TESTED; G7/stable G8 BLOCKED.

relations.text: B47ANCEDUI client API 1 supplies the Rooms editor's shared presentation controls.
